explanation: Tyrosine 181 makes critical van der Waals contacts with nevirapine's aromatic ring system within the NNRTI-binding pocket; the Y181C mutation replaces a bulky aromatic residue with a smaller thiol-containing cysteine, eliminating favorable π-π stacking interactions and reducing the surface complementarity that stabilizes the inhibitor. Additionally, the loss of the hydroxyl group removes a hydrogen-bonding interaction (either direct to NVP or via water-mediated stabilization), further destabilizing the inhibitor-protein complex. The dramatic reduction in contact surface area at this critical position within the pocket causes a substantial decrease in binding affinity without requiring compensatory conformational changes.
